archetype: The Performance Pro / Swiss Luxury Hybrid

sizes.page_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-[32px] font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1c1c1c]

body_and_ui.labels_and_captions: text-xs sm:text-[13px] font-medium tracking-wide text-[#666666] uppercase

colors.rules: No gradients, no neon colors, strict 1px solid borders #ececec. High contrast, clean surfaces.

console_back_office.navigation: Left sticky sidebar with collapsible sub-navigation and top bar with search, multi-store selector, language toggle (FR/EN), dark/light mode toggle, offline status indicator.
console_back_office.grid_mode: High Density Grid (MODE B) with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) for dashboards, tabular data, POS split view.

delivery_space.navigation: Bottom tab bar with 4 tabs: Mes courses, Historique, Encaissements, Profil

public_storefront.navigation: Header with brand logo, search bar, language/currency indicator, cart drawer trigger, customer account menu
public_storefront.grid_mode: Tetris & Product Cards Grid (MODE A) with 2-4 columns on desktop, 1-2 on mobile

components_and_styling.cards: rounded-[12px] border border-[#ececec] bg-[#f8f8f8] p-5 shadow-none transition-colors hover:border-[#f4b12c]/50
components_and_styling.primary_button: bg-[#f4b12c] text-[#1c1c1c] font-semibold rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 hover:bg-[#e4991e] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center gap-2
components_and_styling.secondary_button: bg-white text-[#1c1c1c] border border-[#1c1c1c] font-semibold rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 hover:bg-[#f5f5f5] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all min-h-[44px]
components_and_styling.destructive_button: bg-transparent text-[#c62828] border border-[#c62828] font-semibold rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 hover:bg-[#c62828]/10 transition-all
components_and_styling.data_tables: sticky header, search input, filter popovers, sortable columns, pagination bar, bulk action toolbar, export CSV/PDF button, zebra striping with #f8f8f8 and hover highlight with #ffdc98
components_and_styling.inputs_and_selects: use custom styled inputs/selects with border-[#ececec] focus:border-[#0021cc] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0021cc] bg-white rounded-md text-sm p-2.5

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, tables, rows, tabs, dropdown items, KPI blocks) MUST carry `data-testid` formatted in kebab-case e.g. `data-testid="pos-add-to-cart-button"`, `data-testid="storefront-product-card-1"`, `data-testid="rider-tab-mes-courses"`
testing_and_accessibility.toast_notifications: Use `sonner` via `toast.success()`, `toast.error()`, `toast.info()` for instant feedback across POS actions, delivery status updates, order checkout, and settings saving.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a unified application with three clear view modes: (1) Back-Office Console, (2) Delivery Rider Mobile Space, (3) Public Storefront.
Support offline-first behavior in POS and Delivery space with local state sync indicators.
Implement bilingual support (French default + English toggle) with local storage persistence and FCFA formatting ('25 000 FCFA').
Enforce strict 1px solid borders (#ececec), cards with 12px radius, yellow accent buttons, and IBM Plex Serif for headings.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for automated test coverage.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Ensure WCAG AA contrast against backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.file_extension: Use .js and .jsx files as this project is structured in JavaScript React.
